{{Quote|The capital city of Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states. Perched atop Capitoline Hill, it boasts towering stone structures that form the grand "Gryphon's Fortress." After fleeing the threat of the Dark Tide, the bold and battle-loving Septimontians have devoted their lives to chasing the heights of glory. With travelers from distant seas, they gather in this City of Glory built upon the legends of heroes.|[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main#regions ''Wuthering Waves Official Website'']}} 

'''Capitoline Hill City''' is a subarea located in {{Location|Capitoline Hill|nocat=1}} and the capital city of Septimont. 

==Trivia==
* '''Capitoline Hill''' (''Mons Capitolinus; Campidoglio'') or '''Capitolium''' is one of the {{w|Seven Hills of Rome}}, earlier known as ''Mons Saturnius'' and dedicated to Roman god {{w|Saturn (mythology)|Saturn}}.
=== Etymology ===
* "''Capitoline''" is a precursor to the English word ''capitol'' and borrowed from the Latin word ''capitulum''.
** ''Capitulum'' is formed from the Latin word ''caput'' ("head") and the diminutive suffix ''-ulum''.
